name: Lab monitor - study (eye tracker)
description: Controls and patients: 24-2 (52 points) at 33 cm with a chin rest, Full Threshold 4-2 staircase (OPI), seeds at the middle of the dB range, fixation by the Tobii eye tracker (start python/specvis.sh tracker-bridge first). Use the measured screen width and the ColorCAL luminance scale.
